project_context.design_archetype: The Performance Pro mixed with Swiss Brutalist

headings.rules: Use tight tracking (tracking-tight), never use Inter for headings. Keep weight contrast high (e.g., Light vs Bold).

mono_data.rules: Use for all trace logs, latencies, node IDs, and tool calls. tracking-[0.05em] uppercase for overlines.

colors.rules: Never use pure black or pure gray. Use zinc/slate tinted darks. Never use #7351B7 or #1B93A4. Agent colors must be used strategically for glowing accents, badges, and active trace borders, not as massive backgrounds.

customer_chat.description: Reject standard left/right iMessage bubbles. Use a vertical timeline/feed approach. AI responses should render as 'Cards' containing both the conversational text and a mini-activity feed showing the agent's actions (e.g. 'Supervisor routing to Billing...', 'Tool called: lookup_invoice').
customer_chat.spacing: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 for chat blocks to allow them to breathe.

admin_dashboard.description: Every pixel utilized. Use h-full on children. Display traces as vertical node trees or Gantt-like latency bars.
admin_dashboard.surface: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-white/10), no drop-shadows. Retro-futuristic terminal touches for live logs.

visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: Use for the active agent card or active handoff visualization. An animated border glow matching the agent's color (e.g. using Framer Motion to move a gradient along the border).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use for sticky headers, Clarification Modals, and the chat input bar. backdrop-blur-2xl bg-zinc-950/60 border border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.grid_borders: For the admin dashboard logs, use visible structural borders (border-r border-b border-white/5) to expose the skeletal layout.

components_strategy.buttons: Sharp rectangular with 1px border or completely borderless with high-contrast background. Hover state must lift (-translate-y-1) and increase brightness.
components_strategy.avatars: Do not use standard circle stock photos. Use abstract 3D nodes or minimalistic iconography surrounded by a colored glowing ring indicating the agent's active status.
components_strategy.chat_messages: Flat, sharp edges with a subtle 4px or 0px rounding. Content must be structured (markdown, code blocks, tool receipts).
components_strategy.traces: Use vertical steppers with JetBrains Mono for timestamps, latency, and tool invocations.

motion.handoff: When agent changes, the new agent badge slides in from top with a subtle spring bounce. The old badge fades out. The trace beam color transitions smoothly.
motion.loading: Do not use generic spinners. Use sequential fading text 'Analyzing intent...', 'Routing...', 'Querying API...' or a geometric ASCII art loader.
motion.page_transitions: Staggered entrance for dashboard bento cards (delay 50-100ms per card).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against dark backgrounds meets APCA/WCAG standards (e.g. text-zinc-400 or lighter on zinc-950).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid in kebab-case.

dashboard_background.description: Network of dots for admin login or background accent layer (set to extremely low opacity like 5%).

trace_visualization_bg.description: Abstract blue lines for the active trace path backdrop. Crop and overlay with dark mask.

agent_avatar_tech.description: 3D character avatar for Tech Support Agent (fallback representation).

agent_avatar_supervisor.description: 3D gold/black abstract geometric structure to represent the central Supervisor Agent.

agent_avatar_human_fallback.description: Professional realistic portrait for human escalation routing.

icons.usage: Use crisp, minimalist icons. Avoid heavy filled icons. For tech/admin, size 16px to 20px.

universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. DO NOT create a standard chat UI. This is an 'AI Command Center' that visualizes thought processes.
Use 2-3x more spacing than usual. Container padding should be p-8 instead of p-4.
Never apply `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `transition: transform 0.2s, opacity 0.2s`.
Do not center-align the main app container. Maintain strict left alignment for text to support reading speed.
Prioritize high-quality glass-morphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-zinc-950/70) for overlays and sticky headers.
NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds behind text. Always use a solid or blurred scrim.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, message bubbles, trace nodes).
Create depth using z-index and subtle colored glows matching the active agent (e.g., #10b981 for Billing).
Do not use Shadcn default roundings or default generic borders. Customize with sharp edges (rounded-none or rounded-sm) and 1px white/10 borders.
Use sonner for toast notifications. Set toasts to use dark mode matching the application.
